text:
Maya: quick idea — run a tiny compatibility 'preflight' before we kick off the full smoke bench. catch tokenizer/ABI issues early and avoid burning lots of bench cycles.
Liam: sounds good. what are the absolutely minimal checks? tokenizer mapping + shape sanity?
Sofia: minimal set: 1) tokenizer id mapping for a few canonical strings, 2) kv-cache layout check (shapes/dtypes), 3) micro-forward that verifies output shape and a tiny numerical sanity check. all cheap.
Maya: implement as an entry-gate that aims for <1s on a warmed image: token-verify + micro-forward(1 seq) -> enqueue bench if pass.
Liam: representation: we should return structured failure reasons, not just pass/fail. makes trend analysis possible.
Sofia: agree. small schema: reason_code, component, evidence_snippet. e.g. TOKEN_ID_MISMATCH | tokenizer | "token id 102 != expected 103". store in model.metadata.
Alex: micro-forward caveat: kernel selection differences may give false negatives if the preflight runs on a different kernel set than production. for Dedicated/Private run in same sandbox image; for hosted consider a fingerprint-based emulator.
DevOpsBot: note: deploy preflight v1 to intake-workers pool image=ml-sandbox:v2026-04-01.
Maya: gate versioning is important. semver the gate logic and include gate_version in intake record for reproducibility.
Liam: also pin tokenizer spec and opset-map versions.
Sofia: tradeoff: moving checks left increases latency for the initial response to the user, but saves bench resource consumption. make it policy-driven per org/team: "fast" vs "strict" profiles.
Alex: quantized model nuance: small numeric differences across hardware are expected. add a tolerance field (none/medium/lenient) documented in intake.yaml; default=medium.
Maya: implementation sketch: 1) token probe (stateless) 2) micro-forward deterministic seed + golden compare (L2 norm) 3) short-circuit on fail.
Sofia: pseudo snippet:
```
seed=1337
a = randint(seed, (1,16))
out = model.forward(a)
if l2(out, golden)/norm(golden) > THRESH: fail(reason="GOLDEN_DELTA")
```
Liam: where to store goldens? small artifacts in immutable blobstore keyed by model-family+gate-version. content-hash and readonly updates.
Maya: index failures in bigtable so product and SRE can query failure rates and reasons.
DevOpsBot: metric created: entry_gate.fail_rate (1m/5m). alert if >3 failed intakes in 1h.
Alex: rollout plan: alpha internal models (1w), opt-in beta for hosted customers, then default for new intakes. include an opt-out flag.
Liam: docs & remediation playbooks: I'll draft a short doc with examples (bad tokenizer remediations, re-run steps).
Sofia: I'll prototype micro-runner and golden-compare PR by Friday, test on amd64 + nvidia images.
Maya: action items recap:
- Liam: schema + docs (EOD Wed)
- Sofia: prototype runner + tests (PR Fri)
- Alex: tolerance semantics for quantized binaries (sync Thu)
- Ops: gate-versioning + metrics (DevOpsBot noted)
Maya: also ensure logs redact weights and secrets; only store hashes and short evidence.
Alex: good call. redact any raw tensors in logs.
DevOpsBot: reminder: intake-workers scheduled maintenance tomorrow 02:00-03:00 UTC.
Maya: we'll avoid heavy canary runs in that window. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
